title: Scroll edge
description: A soft fade on the edge of a scrolling area where more content continues, like Apple's: only on that side, gone at the end of the scroll. Modal, Drawer and confirmDialog have it built in; SCROLL_EDGE + useScrollEdges give it to your own scroller on the panel surface. It is the one gradient Semi allows (C-022).
when: Your own fixed-height scroller on bg-panel (a terms box, a list in a popover) whose content can be longer than the box.
Nothing to do in Modal, Drawer or confirmDialog: they already show it.

instead.need: A scrolling list in a card, with edge lines and an optional scrollbar
Columns past the edge of a table

a11y: The fades are aria-hidden and pointer-events-none: they never take a click or a tap.
Make the scroller focusable while it scrolls (tabIndex={edges.scrolls ? 0 : undefined}) and name it, so arrow keys can scroll it.
The fade is an opacity change in 150ms (transition-hover), with no transition under reduced motion.
notes: Never copy SCROLL_EDGE's value: semi-lint's gradient rule lets only the constant itself through.
The fade goes from the panel colour to transparent: use it on bg-panel (dialogs, drawers, the content card). The system overlay scrollbar stays as it is.
